description:
Role Description & Key Responsibilities

1. Platform Development & Customization

• Provide advanced hands-on development and configuration support across ServiceNow

modules,

including ITSM, App Engine, and Portals.

• Leverage out-of-the-box capabilities.

• Adhere to ServiceNow development standards and best practices.

2. Technical Development & Quality Assurance (QA)

• Independently review and validate development activities, customizations, scripts,

workflows, and fixes

delivered by other developers.

• Ensure code quality, maintainability, performance, and compliance with approved technical

designs.

• Write and execute test scripts.

3. Platform Optimization & Knowledge Transfer

• Identify opportunities to improve platform performance, automation, usability, and technical

efficiency.

• Maintain development documentation.

• Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to SOPC teams to support the longterm

sustainability of the platform.

4. Agile Development

• Follow Agile development methodologies.

• Utilize ServiceNow products and capabilities.

Mandatory Requirements

1. Professional Experience

• Minimum 7 years of overall technical experience.

• At least 5 years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience.

2. Technical Skills & Expertise

Hands-on experience implementing the following ServiceNow modules, technologies, and

capabilities:

• Customer Service Management (CSM)

• Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM)

• Portals

• REST/SOAP APIs

• Integration Hub

• Document Management

• App Engine

• Dashboards

• Platform Analytics

• Playbooks

• Workspaces

3. Required ServiceNow Certifications

All of the following certifications are mandatory:

• CSA – Certified System Administrator

• CAD – Certified Application Developer

• CIS-ITSM – Certified Implementation Specialist – IT Service Management

• CIS-CSM – Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management

• CIS-SPM – Certified Implementation Specialist – Strategic Portfolio Management
